milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate close to the potted dead bush (within 5 blocks) and face toward it (within 60° tolerance), confirming they have actually located and visually identified the block inside the shelter. max_distance reduced from 16 to 5 to prevent trivial completion from spawn position (player starts ~5 blocks away in Z but not facing the target).
